description:
Get disease indications and clinical trial phases for a drug.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table drug_indications — one record = one indication (disease) of one drug with its maximum phase.
Key: id, indications[].disease, indications[].maxPhaseForIndication, indications[].references.
Arguments: drug_id accepts chembl molecule or drug name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by indications[].maxPhaseForIndication desc, then indications[].disease asc (verified by the harness); one row = one item (one indication (disease) of one drug with its maximum phase); `_vbt.total` counts items.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. ChEMBL drug indications; absence means none curated.

drug_id.description: Accepts chembl_molecule, drug_name; resolved to one chembl_molecule (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
